decisions.reason: The exact LCSC part number identifies the already-selected ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 module but does not change any confirmed GPIO assignment or compatibility policy.
Confirming the module's LCSC part number does not change the panel connector inventory, signals, or on-board button policy.
The module procurement identifier does not alter the auxiliary regulator, source selection, powered rail, or standalone-programming behavior.
The confirmed LCSC identifier does not change the ESP32-S3 load identity in a way that alters the DCDC1 voltage, rating, or normal-operation role.
The module part-number confirmation does not change the boost converter, GPIO5 enable control, powered loads, or low-power policy.
The shared phrase 'part number' is incidental; the source identifies the ESP32 module and does not affect the battery connector or its unresolved pin order.
This Requirement concerns the power-board BOM, while the source confirms the main-board ESP32 module's LCSC identifier; no current power-board BOM attribute necessarily changes.
The exact procurement identifier for the already-selected ESP32-S3 module does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, topology, speed, or cable assumptions.
The module LCSC part number does not alter the LED part, supply voltage, data GPIO, level shifting, or standby-power control.
Confirming the procurement identifier for the already-selected module does not change USB data routing, connector requirements, or programming-port behavior.
The source concerns the main controller module and does not change the separate sensor board's connector-fanout role.
The module's LCSC identifier does not alter the AXP2101 power source, battery voltage range, or system-load coverage.
